text:
anya: Heads-up — diff view on the scorecard shows a weird shift for the quantized-run vs baseline around short prompts. looks like a distribution shift, not just mean drop. https://redwood.internal/diff/qexp-2026-03-18
devin: which metric is spiking? mean or percentile?
anya: percentile_50 and percentile_90 both move but in opposite directions for some buckets. small prompt lengths (<40 tokens) show improved p90 but p50 drops. screenshot in thread.
kevin: that pattern smells like inconsistent bucketing between runs. did the harness change bucket key from prompt_length to token_count?
sarah: good call. I remember a change to the eval metric defs last week — might have renamed the field. i'll pull the metric yaml.
anya: here's the runner config snippet from the quantize job we used:
```yaml
metrics:
  - name: exact_match
    agg: percentile_50
    bucket_by: prompt_length
  - name: rouge_l
    agg: mean
    bucket_by: prompt_length
```
anya: and the baseline run uses: `bucket_by: token_count` (ugh)
devin: bingo. that would shift which examples fall into each bucket and explain opposite-direction deltas.
kevin: can we normalize the binning post-ingest in the dashboard as a quick fix? or we should re-run the quantized eval with aligned bucket key.
sarah: dashboard normalization is doable but brittle. re-running with aligned bucket is safer for the eval signal. command to re-run: `./eval-runner --run-id qexp-2026-03-18-realign --bucket-key prompt_length --seed 42`
ci-bot: nightly-evals: queued job qexp-2026-03-18-realign (CI job 4521).
kevin: I pushed a tiny validation to the eval harness to emit a warning when bucket keys differ between runs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/eval-harness/pull/1187
kevin: patch includes a small lint that compares metric defs across baseline/target and prints a table.
anya: awesome. can you also emit an annotation in telemetry so dashboard can surface the mismatch?
kevin: adding an observability annotation now — observability-bot will create a flagged run.
observability-bot: flagged-run created: qexp-2026-03-18 (bucket-key-mismatch) — visible in Scorecards > Diff View
devin: after re-run, compare raw sample alignment too. sometimes small sampling changes shift percentiles. use `--preserve-seed` and `--preserve-sample-list` options if available.
sarah: re-run finished (CI/4521) — summary: p50 delta reduced, p90 still shows small improvement for quantized at short prompts. looks like original signal was mostly bucket mismatch.
anya: great. i'm going to update the dashboard docs to call out bucket-key alignment as precondition for diff views. also add a quickcheck to the scorecard pipeline to error when mismatched.
kevin: filed an issue for pipeline quickcheck: https://github.com/redwood-inference/scorecards/issues/342
anya: marking this thread as resolved once docs PR lands. thanks all :thumbsup:
sarah: docs PR is up: #709, includes example command, and a snippet for the scorecard quickcheck.
devin: can we add a small example in the UI drilldown that links to the sample list so reviewers can sanity-check the alignment?
kevin: yes, adding a "compare sample IDs" button in drilldown — I'll prototype in next sprint.
anya: closing loop: root cause = inconsistent bucket key (prompt_length vs token_count) between baseline and quantized runs. remediation = re-run with aligned bucket key + harness lint + dashboard annotation + docs.
anya: thanks, closing. :white_check_mark:
